It’s 1/9 scale, and running two 80mm EDFs that move a ton of air. Rotating metal landing gear with sequential doors, huge battery bay so you can fit two 6s Lipo batteries to power this monster. Giving my RC Plane MORE POWER! Converting this FMS F4U Corsair from 6s to 8s. This was honestly the best mod for this plane and was extremely simple. By taking out the old 80 amp ESC and replacing it with a new 120 amp ESC allows us to run 8s on this big bird. Since I’ll be running two 4s 6000mah Lipo batteries, I added a dual EC5 connector and had to make a small notch in my canopy. Unbelievably, this actually helps CG out the plane better with the extra nose weight. If you haven’t watch my flight video, please do! #rcplane #corsair #radiocontrol #remotecontrol #rchobby
